name: @geoquery/python
//: Façade so turbo can see the native Python SDK as one node in the repo-wide task graph. Pixi owns Python, maturin, and the Rust toolchain; `pixi run py-install` builds the PyO3 extension in editable mode. Every script `cd ../..` to the repository root because the ruff `src` config, pytest paths, and coverage output are resolved from there.

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && ruff check python/geoquery && ruff format --check python/geoquery
scripts.fmt: cd ../.. && ruff check --fix python/geoquery && ruff format python/geoquery
scripts.dist: cd ../.. && rm -rf dist/pypi && mkdir -p dist/pypi && cd python/geoquery && maturin build --release --out ../../dist/pypi
